notes.title: Spell echo - Abyss mode activated
notes.content:
Update content:
1. New mode - Abyss mode activated
2. Revise known bugs

notes.title: Spell Echo Game Update on February 10th
notes.content:
newly added:

Increase the number of spell combo effects in Leisure Mode.

New spell field shortcut key setting function (valid for construction mode and abyss mode).

Added the function of pausing during battles by pressing the Esc key on the keyboard.



Optimization:

After 4 minutes in leisure mode, there will be a buffering countdown process when returning to combat from the non combat interface to avoid the abrupt feeling of suddenly returning to combat.

After receiving new spell rewards in Leisure Mode, the combo interface will automatically open for players to adjust the order of spells.

[Leisure Mode] Reward optimization, adding more spell refinement rewards.

【 Leisure Mode 】 Reward optimization, now you can directly choose artifact rewards.

The function of [Adjust Order] in [Leisure Mode] is optimized. Now, first select the spell you want to adjust, and then click the [Adjust Order] button to directly insert the spell to the desired position.

【 Leisure Mode 】 Optimized repelling effect during battles.

Optimization of floating character performance in battles.

Optimization of game settings, allowing for switching between game language and operating modes within the game.



Bug：

Fixed the issue of abnormal duration of the dizziness effect attached to the Lord skill in Leisure Mode.

Fixed the issue of popping sound in some skill sound effects in Leisure Mode.

Fixed the issue where the game did not pause when the pause interface was called out during battles in casual mode.

Fixed the issue of occasional abnormal display of spell insertion position effects in the 'Leisure Mode' interface.

Fix other known bugs.
